definitions.explanation: A general term for birds that live on or near water, including ducks, geese, swans, herons, and similar species.

examples.english: There are waterfowl on the pond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水鳥|みずとり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many waterfowl gather at the park's lake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、シベリア⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧くる{水鳥|みずとり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}できる→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: In winter, you can observe waterfowl that migrate from Siberia.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term covering various species of aquatic birds. Often seen in nature writing, birdwatching contexts, and environmental topics. Japan is an important wintering ground for many migratory waterfowl.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水鳥|みずとり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧ (to observe waterfowl)
- {水鳥|みずとり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ (waterfowl swimming)
- ⟦{渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}→渡り鳥：09252_wataridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水鳥|みずとり} (migratory waterfowl)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{野鳥|やちょう}→野鳥：14497_yachou⟧: wild bird — broader category including all wild birds
- ⟦{渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}→渡り鳥：09252_wataridori⟧: migratory bird — specifically birds that migrate seasonally
